lyrics.text: Up on the roof with a blanket and you
Tracing the shapes that we made when we knew
Nothing of leaving and nothing of rain
We named every star and they all stayed the same
So draw me a map of the summer sky
Here is the kite and the dog running by
Here are two friends with their hands held tight
Call me on Sunday and say it's alright
Your car's packed up and your mother is proud
I'm smiling so hard that I can't say it loud
A thousand miles is just lines on a chart
But stars are just fire that is burning apart
So draw me a map of the summer sky
Here is the kite and the dog running by
Here are two friends with their hands held tight
Call me on Sunday and say it's alright
And the light that we see
Left a long time ago
It's already gone
We just don't know
So draw me a map of the summer sky
Here is the kite and the dog running by
Here are two friends with their hands held tight
Call me on Sunday and say it's alright
